yaml_comma_separated_lists.title: Comma-separated lists in the YAML configuration
yaml_comma_separated_lists.description:
The YAML configuration of {stops} still sets {options} as a comma-separated string. These options now take a list of values, and support for the comma-separated form will be removed in a future release.

Edit `configuration.yaml` and write each value as its own list item, e.g.:

```yaml
sensor:
  - platform: berlin_transport
    departures:
      - name: "S+U Schönhauser Allee"
        stop_id: 900110001
        excluded_lines:
          - S41
          - S42
```

Restart Home Assistant afterwards. This notice does not come back once no stop uses the old form.
